description: This file defines a Swift class `GatewayDiscoveryModel` responsible for managing network gateway discovery using Bonjour/mDNS services. It handles starting/stopping discovery, maintaining a list of discovered gateways, logging debug information, and managing browser states for network service discovery.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel
classes.description: A final class that manages network gateway discovery using Bonjour/mDNS, including starting/stopping discovery, handling the list of gateways, and managing debug logs.

classes.name: DebugLogEntry
classes.description: A struct representing a debug log entry with timestamp and message.

classes.name: DiscoveredGateway
classes.description: A struct representing a network gateway discovered via Bonjour, including identifiers, name, endpoint details, and optional configurations.

methods.name: setDebugLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug logging, clearing logs when disabling.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins network service discovery for gateways across configured domains.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops ongoing network discovery, cancels browsers, and clears internal data.

methods.name: recomputeGateways
methods.description: Updates the list of currently discovered gateways, tracking additions/removals, and updates debug logs accordingly.

methods.name: updateStatusText
methods.description: Updates the status text based on current browser states.

methods.name: appendDebugLog
methods.description: Appends a message to debug log if logging is enabled.

methods.name: prettyState
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string for an `NWBrowser.State`.

methods.name: prettifyInstanceName
methods.description: Formats and cleans up instance names for readability.

methods.name: txtValue
methods.description: Retrieves a trimmed string value from a dictionary, or nil if empty.

methods.name: txtIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves an integer value from a dictionary based on a key.

methods.name: txtBoolValue
methods.description: Interprets a dictionary value as boolean.
